title: Call to Obedience

questions.question: What did Moses urge Israel to keep to live in the land?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:1 (ESV): "And now, O Israel, listen to the statutes and the rules... and do them, that you may live..."

questions.question: What did Moses warn against adding or subtracting?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:2 (ESV): "You shall not add to the word that I command you, nor take from it..."

questions.question: What event did Moses recall to show God’s judgment?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:3 (ESV): "Your eyes have seen what the LORD did at Baal-peor..."

questions.question: What unique experience did Israel have at Horeb?
options: They heard God’s voice but saw no form
questions.correctAnswer: They heard God’s voice but saw no form
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:12 (ESV): "Then the LORD spoke to you out of the midst of the fire. You heard the sound of words, but saw no form; there was only a voice."

questions.question: What did Moses predict if Israel turned to idols?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:27 (ESV): "And the LORD will scatter you among the peoples..."

questions.question: What makes Israel a great nation in the sight of other peoples?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:8 (ESV): "And what great nation is there that has statutes and rules so righteous as all this law..."

questions.question: What were they to watch carefully lest they forget?
options: The things their eyes had seen
questions.correctAnswer: The things their eyes had seen
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:9 (ESV): "Only take care... lest you forget the things that your eyes have seen..."

questions.question: What type of images were forbidden?
options: Any likeness of male or female, beast, bird, creeping thing, or fish
questions.correctAnswer: Any likeness of male or female, beast, bird, creeping thing, or fish
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:16-18 details all these forms as forbidden images.

questions.question: What celestial bodies were they warned not to worship?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:19 (ESV): "And beware lest you raise your eyes to heaven, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars... you be drawn away and worship them..."

questions.question: The Lord is described as what kind of fire?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:24 (ESV): "For the Lord your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God."

questions.question: How many cities of refuge did Moses set apart east of the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:41 (ESV): "Then Moses set apart three cities in the east beyond the Jordan..."

questions.question: What were the names of the three cities of refuge in the east?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:43 (ESV): "Bezer in the wilderness... Ramoth in Gilead... and Golan in Bashan..."

questions.question: From where did God speak the Ten Commandments?
options: Out of the midst of the fire
questions.correctAnswer: Out of the midst of the fire
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:12 (ESV): "Then the Lord spoke to you out of the midst of the fire."

questions.question: What metaphor is used for Egypt in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:20 (ESV): "But the Lord has taken you and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt..."

questions.question: If they sought God from exile, when would they find Him?
options: When they search with all their heart and soul
questions.correctAnswer: When they search with all their heart and soul
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 4:29 (ESV): "But from there you will seek the Lord your God and you will find him, if you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul."

key_verse_text: But from there you will seek the LORD your God and you will find him, if you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul. (ESV)
